5.subject: Summary of the client meeting
5.body:
Hi John,

Here is a summary of the client meeting held on May 5, 2024:

Overview:
- Discussed client requirements for the new project.
- Agreed on the project timeline and key milestones.
- Reviewed initial design concepts and gathered feedback.

Action Items:
- Emma will update the project plan based on feedback.
- David will coordinate with the development team to initiate the first phase.
- Next meeting date: 2024-06-01.

Please find the meeting minutes document attached.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
